hash_chain.equivalence: match exactly when expected == H(seq_bytes, 0x77a00858ddd37f21) ^ H(user_key, 0) ^ H(value, 0xd28aad72f49bd50b) ^ H(value_type_byte, 0xa5155ae5e937aa16); the code isolates H(value_type_byte) on one side of the comparison, which is algebraically the same condition

layout.entry: buffer after the length prefix, exactly L bytes: user_key = entry[0:L-8], trailer = entry[L-8:L] little-endian
layout.length_prefix: first byte below 0x80 is the length and the payload starts one byte later; otherwise the 32-bit varint helper 0x541cec0 decodes it (7-bit groups, shifts 0/7/14/21/28, failure returns a null pointer)
layout.trailer: low byte = value type, next 7 bytes = 56-bit sequence (trailer >> 8)
layout.value: starts after the entry end; its own length prefix follows the same single-byte/varint rule, and its bytes must extend exactly to the buffer end

length_gates.order: first, after the length prefix decodes

length_gates.check: buffer bytes remaining after the length prefix < L
